_doc: The owner list of the landmark registry (P2-005; DELHI_WORLD.md 1 'Tiers', 9 'Owner answers', CITY_BRIEF.md 'Landmarks'). A line claims a landmark by its ids, never by its name: 'wikidata' is the Wikidata item, 'osm' the OpenStreetMap object that draws it (both ids on one line join the two by hand). 'tier' wins over the score of the registry build (tools/bake/landmarks/tier.ts); an edit in landmarks.overrides.json wins over this list. 'said' records who named it and where. 'hero_later' marks a landmark that becomes a hero when its model is made; it stays at 'tier' until then. A line whose landmark lies outside the outline of the baked stage is a far landmark: it is listed with its real bearing and distance from the block pivot and drawn on the backdrop only. 'block_planned' names the block it will stand in once that block is baked. Places the owner named that lie in stages not baked yet and are not skyline marks (Khan Market, Delhi Gymkhana, the Golf Club, the IGI terminal, Lodhi Garden tombs, Hauz Khas, Malcha Mahal) get their line when their stage is baked.
